title: Abuse and failure sweep (protocol E.6 / section 2) -- Part 2 of 3 -- from S05-exit, cases 10-13
_source: ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md E.6, transcribed mechanically per ralph/GATE_F_INSTRUMENTATION_REQUEST.md section 6. Entry saves per protocol B: S03-exit and S05-exit.
_lane: SEGMENT_SCHEMA.md lists `journey` and `diag` as the lane values. This segment is neither: protocol 0.1 names two lanes, JOURNEY (S01-S10) and STUDY/DIAG (X01-X08), and only the segments prefixed DIAG- inside that second lane may take a shortcut. `study` is that distinction written down rather than collapsed into `diag`, which would read as permission this segment does not have. The field is informational either way -- the per-step `diag` flag is what actually permits a shortcut, and no step here carries one.
_rule: E.6's own preamble: 'All on production paths, each with expected/actual telemetry.' Nothing here is granted and free_build stays OFF.
_no_teleport: X06 is not a DIAG segment and contains no teleport step. Every locked route below is approached by walking, because whether the world explains the lock diegetically on arrival is the whole point of case 11.
_defect_shots: Protocol G: 'Defect shots (GF-22/DEF-...) are the only operator-added captures: context frame first, then a diagnostic close view if useful, at first occurrence, as-found.' They are therefore NOT pre-planned in this file. Case 6's 'record any clip/soft-lock with position (GF-22 defect shots)' is an instruction to the operator at the moment of a find, not a planned frame.
_comment_evidence_lane: X06 (abuse and failure cases) plans no §G frame, so it hands nothing over and needs no capture lane -- the harness allows exactly that. It is declared a logic lane anyway for the OTHER half of the declaration: without it the segment inherits §H's default 0.1 Hz continuous record, which under a 12.7 s rendered frame is the 4.6-million-frame recording the split was created to delete, and which headless would write as file:null rows while every step said PASS.
_split: T2-GATEF-RUN6 cost split, the same remedy T2-S10-COST applied to S10 and the one T2-GATEF-RUN5's handover asked for (§8.3, §11.5). X06 whole was refused before step 1 by the harness capture pre-flight: 2,525,320 planned frames, predicted 14,960 s against the 14,400 s ceiling -- 4% over. Splitting at the segment's own entry-save seam is not enough on its own: part 1 (from S03-exit) prices at ~650 s but part 2 (from S05-exit) still prices at ~14,863 s. So part 2 is split again at its own `case 8` boundary, where the previous case has just closed its menu shell and nothing is carried in flight. Each part re-seeds its own entry save through the real title screen, exactly as the original did at X06-004 and X06-182, so no part depends on another having run. Nothing is dropped: the three parts are the original 314 steps plus one repeated 10-step load preamble.
